scenes.headline: How a Diffusion Transformer turns noise into an image
scenes.sub: Latents, patches, adaLN-Zero, joint attention and rectified flow
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Thimble! Most new image models remove noise with a Diffusion Transformer. Here's how one works.

scenes.text: Cut a noisy latent image into patches, treat the patches as tokens, and let the noise level steer every block through its norms.
scenes.say: Cut a noisy latent into patches, treat them as tokens, and let the noise level steer every block.

steps.say: An encoder shrinks the image eight times per side, and training adds noise to it.
steps.note: training adds noise to the latent

steps.say: Cut the latent into two by two patches: two hundred fifty-six tokens.
Twenty-eight Transformer blocks let every token read every other.

steps.note: then remove a little, and go again
steps.say: Out comes the predicted noise. Remove a little, and go again.

scenes.title: adaLN-Zero: the noise level steers
scenes.say: So how does the noise level get in?

parts.note: a scale and a shift, regressed from timestep and label
parts.say: The noise level and the label become a scale and a shift for each norm.

parts.note: a gate, zero at the start: each block begins as the identity
parts.say: Plus a gate that starts at zero, so every block begins as the identity.

parts.note: the MLP gets its own three; together a third of the block
parts.say: The MLP gets its own three. Together they are a third of every block's weights.

left.title: MM-DiT: two streams
items: Text and image keep separate weights
One joint attention over both sequences
left.say: Stable Diffusion three gives text and image separate weights, joined only inside attention.

right.title: Single stream
items: Text projected once into the image stream
One set of weights for every token
right.say: Newer models project the text once, and one set of weights serves every token.

scenes.title: Rectified flow: a straight path
scenes.text: x_t = (1-t) x_0 + t eps   v = eps - x_0
scenes.say: Stable Diffusion three also changed the target.

parts.note: image and noise mixed along a straight line
parts.say: Mix the image and the noise along a straight line.

parts.note: the network predicts the velocity along it
parts.say: Predict the velocity along it, then step from noise back to the image.

scenes.title: Tokens per image, one per 16 x 16 pixels
scenes.say: Every sixteen by sixteen pixels become one token. Double the side, and attention's work grows sixteen times.

scenes.text: A Diffusion Transformer is a Transformer over latent patches: the noise level steers its norms; in text models the prompt joins attention.
scenes.say: A Transformer over latent patches. The noise level steers its norms, and in text models the prompt joins its attention.

recap: adaLN-Zero: scale, shift and gate from the noise
Rectified flow: predict velocity, step toward the image
scenes.say: Patches as tokens, norms steered by the noise, and a straight path to the image.
